info.description: Sprint analytics for Ultimate Frisbee trainings. Times inside a session are integer seconds `t` from its first sample; units are m, s, m/s, m/s² and bpm. Acceleration values are derived from 1 Hz GPS speed.
info.title: Ultimate Analytics API

get.summary: The current analysis parameters and analysis version (read-only)
Frontend settings: the base maps and their tile sources

post.summary: Create a drill type; 409 if the code exists

delete.summary: Delete a drill type; its segments become untyped

get.summary: Metrics of all segments of the drill type, optionally filtered by session start time and surface

post.summary: Create a geozone and match all sessions again (except manual surfaces)

delete.summary: Delete a geozone and match its sessions again; returns the number of affected sessions

patch.summary: Edit a geozone and match all sessions again; returns the number of affected sessions

get.summary: List sessions, newest first; `from` and `to` filter the start time, `to` exclusive

post.summary: Recompute every session analysed with an older analysis version
Upload .fit files or .zip archives of them; one result per FIT file

delete.summary: Delete the session and its raw file

patch.summary: Set the surface (becomes MANUAL) and/or the notes

get.summary: The detected efforts (sprints) with their metrics, in time order

get.description: `from` and `to` are seconds `t` within [0, elapsedSec]; the window covers the seconds from..to-1, so its elapsed time is to - from. Efforts belong to it when they start in it.
get.summary: Metrics of the window [from, to], computed live

post.summary: Analyse the session again from its raw file; segments, notes and a manual surface stay
Create a segment; 409 if it overlaps another one, unless overwrite=true: then the overlapped segments are trimmed, split around it or removed
Merge consecutive segments; the first keeps its drill type and label
Replace all segments with the lap-based ones; requires confirm=true

patch.summary: Edit bounds, drill type or label; 409 if the new bounds overlap another segment

post.summary: Split a segment at atT; both parts keep its drill type and label

get.summary: The full 1 Hz series in columns; null marks gaps
